narrative.details:
Wait, adventurer. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, champion.Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
narrative.requestItemsText: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
